title: Entity audio
responsibility: Presents matching recorded audio before and after a commit or at the current tip.

inputs.name: EntityAudio.evidence
inputs.description: Required explorer evidence from which audio gallery items are selected and grouped by comparison identity. Commit mode creates paired panes; after falls back to current.

inputs.name: EntityAudio.scope
inputs.description: Required selected commit and parent information used in pane labels.

inputs.name: EntityAudio.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required asset prefix passed to each audio card.

outputs.name: EntityAudio
outputs.description: Audio section only when at least one clip exists. Pairs before/after in commit mode and shows one current-side card otherwise. Missing sides within a pair are explicit gaps. Cards supply playback, transcript and provenance. No clips renders nothing, even when a scenario declares audio.
